raw.query: SELECT k AS resolution, ROUND(AVG((v->>'cov50')::numeric), 3) AS avg_cov50, ROUND(AVG((v->>'cov10')::numeric), 3) AS avg_cov10, ROUND(AVG((v->>'band')::numeric), 3) AS avg_band FROM provenance.quantile_coverage, jsonb_each(detail) e(k,v) GROUP BY k ORDER BY CASE k WHEN '1min' THEN 1 WHEN '15s' THEN 2 WHEN '1s' THEN 3 END;
raw.claimed: Median coverage sits near 0.45; the lower edge is distorted by zero-ties (the p10 frequently touches zero on bursty signals), which also deflates the nominal-80% band, more so at finer bins
raw.evidence: Average cov50 at 1-min is 0.467 (near 0.45). At finer bins (1min -> 15s -> 1s), the lower edge cov10 inflates from 0.119 to 0.383 due to zero-ties, deflating the nominal 80% band from 0.768 down to 0.514.
